scheme_name: Scheme Of Coaching & Allied For Scheduled Tribes
other_conditions: Institution must be a registered private institution or NGO
Institution must have at least three years experience running coaching for competitive examinations
Institution must not have been declared bankrupt at any time
Institution must not be blacklisted or debarred by any government body
Institution must have its own building/space to run coaching classes at Ranchi and Dumka
Candidates must be resident of Jharkhand
Candidates must belong to Scheduled Tribe (ST) category
Candidates must have the eligible qualifications for the respective competitive exams
Candidates' annual income (self or parents) must not exceed ₹2,50,000
Admission is based on merit with a maximum of 40 students per class
At least 30% of SC seats should be women candidates and 5% should be disabled candidates
No more than 10% of students in a batch can be from the same district of Jharkhand
Each candidate can receive free coaching for a particular exam only once and a maximum of two coaching courses in total
Institutions cannot charge any fees to beneficiaries
Institutions receive grant only for SC candidates
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly stipend of Rs 1,000 and a boarding/lodging allowance of Rs 2,000 to eligible ST candidates, with course‑specific coaching fees paid to institutions.
documents_required: SC certificate issued by the competent authority
